name: echarts-terminal
description: Terminal renderer plugin for Apache ECharts

scripts.smoke:contract: npm run build && node test/node/terminal-plugin-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-data-label-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-effect-scatter-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-interaction-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-compare-contract.mjs && node test/node/terminal-showcase-contract.mjs
scripts.smoke:bun: npm run smoke:contract && sh -c '"${BUN_BIN:-bun}" run test/node/terminal-plugin-smoke.mjs'
scripts.smoke:deno: npm run build && sh -c '"${DENO_BIN:-deno}" run -A --node-modules-dir=auto --import-map test/deno/import_map.json test/deno/terminal-plugin-smoke.mjs'
